name: Cookie Cart Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Teens start with a 90 day work readiness internship, then can interview for the paid Bakery Program, where you earn while you learn. Cart Captains get a raise.
who_can_apply: The page says teens and youth. No minimum age or GPA is stated. Applicants under 18 need a parent or guardian signature.
pay_detail: Pay rates are not listed. The bakery program is paid job training.
duration: 90 day internship, then bakery program; new intern training starts in fall, spring and summer sessions
deadline_text: The page says applications are always accepted. Session dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. It asks for your contact info, school and GPA, and transcript. If you are under 18, a parent must sign. For questions about your status, email onesmartcookie@cookiecart.org. Do not call.
notes: 1119 W Broadway Avenue, Minneapolis. The page does not say whether the 90 day internship is paid.
